_about: The defeat screen (BattleScene.onLoss): the screen dims to black (dimAlpha, over dimMs), then SQUAD DEFEATED pops in big (titleDelayMs after the dim starts, titlePx), then the story line (storyDelayMs): '<story>' with {floor}, then ' before ' + a random line. withKiller lines name the enemy that landed the last blow ({enemy}); noKiller lines are used when nobody did (a poison tick, a trap...). Then the CONTINUE button (buttonDelayMs) opens the game-over summary (GameOverScene).
withKiller: a {enemy} sent them home in pieces.
a {enemy} wrote the last page of their story.
a {enemy} took their boots as a trophy.
they learned a {enemy} hits harder than it looks.
a {enemy} danced on what was left of them.
a {enemy} decided this was as far as they go.
a {enemy} ended the song of their deeds.
a {enemy} cleaned the floor with them.
a {enemy} turned their last stand into a short one.
a {enemy} added their names to its wall.
noKiller: the dark took them, one by one.
their torches went out for good.
the stones of Soldia claimed them.
the dungeon decided they had seen enough.
